notes:
Passed on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null; no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. Warnings are expected of a Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only stores the seed used by the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks and action.values[*]); the action values are the normalized dimensionless motor commands of Box(-1, 1, (4,)), not SI quantities. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. Not covered: the sim backend (gymnasium.make('Quad-v0')) was not run, because gymnasium, numpy and scipy are not installed where the gate ran and the upstream constructor parses sys.argv; the fake was not compared with the upstream environment. The fake uses explicit Euler at the upstream 200 Hz step while the upstream default is scipy solve_ivp DOP853, and draws with Python's random.Random instead of numpy's generator, so a seed does not reproduce upstream trajectories. The upstream step indexes a scalar reward and a boolean done (quad.py:153-168) and raises TypeError; the fake implements the intended five-value API and returns the scalar reward of reward_wrapper. Only the base Quad-v0 environment is served, not the CoupledWrapper or DecoupledWrapper. The full 18-element state observation is carried; no array is reduced and there is no NOT COVERED array. Only catalogue cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed.
